subject: Email address change — M'Arte
preview: The final step to update the email on your M'Arte account.
heading: Email address change
message: We received a request to change the email address linked to your M'Arte account.
messageSecondary: To complete the process and keep your account secure, please confirm your new email address using the button below.
messageTertiary: Until confirmed, we will continue using your current email address.
highlightBody: Email changes require confirmation so that no one else can take control of your account.
expiry: For your security, this link will expire in 60 minutes.
ignore: If you did not request this change, please disregard this message — your account will remain secure.
